faq.q: What can the court order at the first stage of a Chilliwack foreclosure?
faq.a: Under Rule 21-7 (5) the court may make a final order of foreclosure, order payment of what is due within a court-fixed redemption period with foreclosure in default, or determine or have certified the amount due.

faq.q: Can I put conditions on an offer for a foreclosure in Chilliwack Foreclosures and Court Sales?
faq.a: Conditions such as financing or inspection may be limited or not accepted, depending on the lender's and the court's terms. Speak to Jared and your lawyer before you write an offer.

faq.q: What is a court-ordered sale in Chilliwack Foreclosures and Court Sales?
faq.a: It is a sale of a property supervised by the court after a lender has taken legal action, and the sale needs court approval. Offers are usually made subject to that approval, and other buyers can sometimes bid higher at the hearing.
